title: Story premise ENT085: The Reference Pile Avalanche
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (creative-work struggles). Hook: I can see every reference except my own idea. Takeaway/theme: Translate references into requirements rather than copying their surfaces.
description: A maker wants to build one original toy creature, but reference cards pile so high that the workbench disappears. They select three abstract requirements from the pile, such as rolls, folds, and glows, put the cards aside, and build an original folding wheel-creature from those constraints.
